name: Blacksteel Battle Scarred Knight Helmet
prompt: Create one completely new, editable Blender 3D model of a medieval knight's full-face great helm / bascinet helmet, an unmistakable wearable helmet silhouette rather than a solid sphere or abstract sculpture. Construct the domed dark forged-black-steel skull, slightly pointed crown ridge, flared neck guard and rolled lower steel rim, articulated angular cheek plates, heavy visor and brow, a narrow long horizontal dark eye slit, nose protection, rows of tiny dark breathing holes, reinforced face bands, rivets and circular temple hinges. Make metal realistically metallic and reflective dark gunmetal, almost black, with polished silvery scratches on exposed edges, rough worn areas, multiple irregular hammer dents and dent rims, sword-scored gouges, chipped corners, soot-dark crevices, subtle patches of aged oxidation. Add realistic dimensional layering and shadows so the eye slit and ventilation read as recesses. A battle-worn medieval steel helmet collectible/game prop with credible proportions and a slightly ominous Gothic style. No figure, no mannequin, no additional objects. Save the genuine .blend scene and render a PNG; open the created object in the actual Blender viewport when completed.
